verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a public REST API with a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.yaml) covering /enrich, /runs/{id}, /runs/{id}/result and /datasets, plus scrape, quick_search and search_agent calls. It also documents agent-friendly controls: webhook_url callbacks, dry_run credit estimates, max_credits caps, and an official Go SDK that handles auth, retries, long-polling and pagination. The probe 404s on openapi.json variants do not contradict this, because the spec is served at openapi.yaml. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
